description: This file defines the DatabaseConfigurationController class within the OrangeHRM installer upgrade process. The class handles pre-render logic for database configuration screen, setting up a Vue component and updating application state.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigurationController
classes.description: A controller responsible for managing the database configuration step during the installation upgrade process, utilizing Vue components and session state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by initializing the database info Vue component and updating the current screen state.
